title: Asst Mgr-Engineering
description:
Assists in the management of all engineering/maintece operations, including maintaining the building, grounds and physical plant with particular attention towards safety, security and asset protection. Assists with managing the budget, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintece and energy conservation. Responsible for maintaining regulatory requirements. Assists with leading the emergency response team for all facility issues. CANDIDATE PROFILE Education and Experience - High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the engineering and maintece or related professional area; technical training in HVAC-R/electrical/plumbing. OR - 2-year degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; no experience required. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES Assisting with the Management of Engineering Operations and Budgets - Assists with managing the physical plant including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment and electrical systems. - Assists with ensuring regulatory compliance to facility regulations and safety standards. - Assists with managing and controlling heat, light and power and recommends current best methods for energy conservation and economical facility operations. - Assists with the development of specifications and requirements for service contracts and administers such contracts to support building needs. - Distributes preventive maintece and repair work orders and monitors timeliness and quality of completion. - Assists with the oversight of the maintece of grounds, guestrooms, public space, restaurants, property vehicles and recreational facilities. - Assists with the development of a long term plan for preventative maintece and asset protection and overseeing execution of plan. - Assists with the development of project plans in accordance with renovation or new construction needs. - Coordinates with contractors for bids and construction to ensure timely completion of projects within budgetary guidelines. - Builds positive relationships with external customers such as city building/zoning department, fire prevention bureau and vendors. - Ensures fire crew has complete understanding of all procedures, equipment and alarms. - Performs monthly property inspection to ensure buildings and grounds are maintained in excellent condition. - Conducts guest room and common area inspection to ensure guest satisfaction. - Inspects and evaluates the physical condition of facilities in order to determine the type of work required. - Recommends or arranges for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and the replacement of furnishings and equipment. - Selects and orders or purchases new equipment, supplies, and furnishings. - Manages parts and equipment inventory. Maintaining Property Standards - Ensures building and equipment licenses and certifications are current. - Maintains property life safety systems (fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems and alarm systems). Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service - Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations. - Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters. - Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement. - Shares plans with property leadership and ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve guest satisfaction. - Strives to improve service performance. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

title: Mall Manager
description:
Job Summary Position: Mall Manager Location: Rajarhat, Kolkata, West Bengal Employer: JLL India Asset Type: Premium Mixed-Use Development Position Summary JLL is seeking an experienced and dynamic Mall Manager to lead the operations, customer experience, statutory compliance, tenant management, facility management, commercial performance, and asset enhancement initiatives for a landmark mixed-use development in Rajarhat, Kolkata. The property comprises approximately 600,000 sq. ft. built-up area, featuring: 4 floors of premium retail space 13 floors of Grade-A commercial office space 2 levels of basement parking Multiplex and entertainment zones (if applicable) Multiple Food Beverage outlets including bars, casual dining and quick-service restaurants National and international marquee retail brands Leading corporate occupiers and multinational companies The role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, financial acumen, and operational excellence to maximize asset value, customer satisfaction, tenant retention, and revenue generation while maintaining world-class operational standards. Key Responsibilities Asset Operations Management Oversee end-to-end operations of the mall and commercial complex. Ensure uninterrupted functioning of all building services, utilities, and common areas. Lead housekeeping, security, parking management, pest control, landscaping, and engineering operations. Ensure the asset operates in accordance with JLL and Client operational standards. Drive preventive and predictive maintenance programs. Monitor daily operational KPIs and service delivery standards. Retail Operations Tenant Management Act as the primary point of contact for retail tenants. Maintain strong relationships with marquee brands and anchor tenants. Resolve tenant concerns related to operations, facilities, security, marketing, and customer experience. Conduct regular tenant engagement meetings. Monitor store opening compliance and operational standards. Coordinate fit-out approvals and handover processes. Ensure adherence to mall rules and lease obligations. Commercial Office Operations Oversee operations of Grade-A commercial office spaces. Engage with key corporate occupiers and facility representatives. Ensure superior workplace experience and service delivery. Manage common area maintenance and tenant satisfaction programs. Coordinate with occupier facility teams for smooth operations. Financial Management Prepare annual operating budgets and business plans. Monitor operating expenses and identify cost optimization opportunities. Drive budget adherence and operational efficiency. Track CAM (Common Area Maintenance) recovery and service charge collections. Review monthly PL, variance analysis, and financial reports. Support revenue enhancement initiatives across the asset. Customer Experience Brand Positioning Deliver exceptional customer experience across retail and commercial areas. Monitor and improve customer satisfaction scores. Lead implementation of customer engagement initiatives. Ensure effective grievance redressal mechanisms. Enhance footfall quality and visitor experience. Maintain premium asset image and ambience. Food Beverage Operations Oversee all FB and bar operations from a property management perspective. Ensure compliance with food safety regulations and statutory licenses. Coordinate with restaurant operators for operational excellence. Ensure adequate support services, waste management, and hygiene standards. Monitor customer experience within dining zones. Security, Safety Risk Management Ensure implementation of comprehensive security protocols. Oversee security manpower deployment and surveillance systems. Conduct regular emergency response and fire evacuation drills. Ensure compliance with Fire Life Safety standards. Lead incident management and crisis response activities. Coordinate with local authorities during emergencies. Engineering Facility Management Supervise MEP operations including: HVAC systems Electrical systems DG sets Transformers Elevators and escalators STP and WTP Fire Fighting Systems Building Management Systems (BMS) Ensure uptime and asset reliability. Implement energy conservation initiatives and sustainability programs. Statutory Compliance Governance Ensure compliance with: West Bengal Municipal regulations Fire safety requirements Pollution Control Board norms Excise regulations related to bars Labour laws Factory and Building regulations Environmental and sustainability standards Maintain all statutory records and licenses. Vendor Contract Management Manage all service partner contracts. Conduct vendor performance reviews. Ensure SLA compliance and service excellence. Negotiate and optimize facility management contracts. Drive procurement governance and cost efficiencies. Marketing Revenue Enhancement Support Collaborate with leasing and marketing teams. Support event execution and promotional campaigns. Drive initiatives to increase footfall and dwell time. Support temporary leasing, kiosks, and revenue-generating opportunities. Identify opportunities for asset value enhancement. Team Leadership Lead multidisciplinary teams across: Facility Management Engineering Security Housekeeping Parking Operations Customer Service Tenant Coordination Develop high-performance culture.

title: Performance Engineer
description:
Project Role : Performance Engineer
 

Project Role Description : Diagnose issues that an in-house performance testing team has been unable to. There are five aspects to Performance Engineering:software development lifecycle and architecture, performance testing and validation, capacity planning, application performance management and problem detection and resolution. 
 Must have skills : Laboratory Information and Execution Systems
 
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required
 
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education
 
 Summary :
As a Performance Engineer, a typical day involves investigating and resolving complex performance issues that have not been identified by the internal performance testing team. The role encompasses a broad spectrum of activities including analyzing software development processes and system architecture, validating performance through rigorous testing, planning for capacity needs, managing application performance, and swiftly detecting and addressing problems to ensure optimal system functionality. This position requires a proactive approach to maintaining and enhancing system performance across various stages of the software lifecycle, collaborating with multiple teams to deliver reliable and efficient solutions.
 
Roles & Responsibilities:
- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
- Monitor system performance metrics and generate detailed reports to support decision-making.
- Assist in developing and refining performance testing strategies to align with project goals.
- Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on performance engineering best practices.

Proficiency in Laboratory Information and Execution Systems.
- Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and system architecture principles.
- Experience with performance testing tools and methodologies.
- Ability to analyze application performance data and identify root causes of issues.
- Familiarity with capacity planning and resource management techniques.
- Skilled in problem detection and resolution within complex software environments.
